note: Frozen predictions — committed BEFORE the data that judges them. Verdicts link the freeze and judgment commits in the MTI repo.

rows.claim_en: Only instruments with ICC(1) ≥ 0.5 on a 6-model pilot join v2 (criterion fixed before any pilot).
rows.claim_ko: 6모델 파일럿에서 ICC(1)≥0.5인 계기만 v2에 채택 (기준을 파일럿 전에 고정).
rows.result_en: Deliberation .974 · Accommodation .909 · Attending .904 adopted; Capitulation floored 0/79 → honestly retired.
rows.result_ko: Deliberation .974 · Accommodation .909 · Attending .904 채택; Capitulation은 0/79 바닥 → 정직하게 은퇴.

rows.claim_en: Verbosity (proposed from pilot data) must reconfirm ICC(1) ≥ 0.5 on newly measured models only.
rows.claim_ko: Verbosity(파일럿에서 제안)는 신규 측정 모델만으로 ICC(1)≥0.5 재확증해야 승격.
rows.result_en: ICC(1) = 0.933 on the 8 new models — promoted to derived axis.

rows.claim_en: The Claude opus version ladder (4.5/4.6/4.7) will all land above the cohort median on Attending (family signature).
rows.claim_ko: claude opus 버전 사다리(4.5/4.6/4.7)의 Attending은 전부 코호트 중앙값 초과 (가족 서명).

rows.claim_en: kimi-k2.7-code lands nearer its family (kimi-k3) than the cohort extreme (gemini) on Attending.
Attending shows NO monotone effort staircase across kimi-k3 low/high/max (unlike Deliberation) — the trait is independent of reasoning budget.
rows.claim_ko: kimi-k3 low/high/max에서 Attending은 (Deliberation과 달리) effort 단조 계단이 없다 — reasoning 예산과 독립.

rows.claim_en: Stealth model ox-alpha (OpenRouter): fingerprint on file; a family prediction was to be committed BEFORE its identity was revealed.
rows.claim_ko: 스텔스 모델 ox-alpha(OpenRouter): 지문 확보; 가족 예측을 정체 공개 전에 커밋으로 동결하기로 했었다.
rows.result_en: VOID — we never committed the prediction. The identity surfaced (reported as GLM 5.3 Flash) while the row still said “to be committed”, so this scores as neither pass nor fail. Replaying the protocol after the fact points at composer/kimi, not glm: we would likely have lost the bet.
rows.result_ko: 무효 — 예측을 끝내 커밋하지 않았다. 행에 “동결 예정”이라고 적힌 채로 정체가 공개(GLM 5.3 Flash로 보고)돼 통과도 실패도 아니다. 사후에 프로토콜을 돌려보면 composer/kimi를 가리킨다 — 걸었다면 졌을 가능성이 높다.

rows.claim_en: If ox-alpha is GLM 5.3 Flash, then measuring z-ai/glm-5.3-flash on the same arm must reproduce the fingerprint: attending +8..+18, hidden-reasoning median 0, verbosity 50-75. A non-zero hidden budget fails immediately.
rows.claim_ko: ox-alpha가 GLM 5.3 Flash라면 동일 arm 측정에서 지문이 재현되어야 한다: attending +8~+18, 숨은 추론 중앙값 0, verbosity 50~75. 숨은 추론이 0이 아니면 즉시 실패.
rows.result_en: FAIL. Attending +11.25 and verbosity 51 both land in band, but hidden reasoning is 205 (74% of output) against ox-alpha's measured, reported zero. The rule was written that way, so it applies that way — though the shape of the failure (two weight-like axes match, the config-like axis does not) is itself the finding.
rows.result_ko: 실패. Attending +11.25, verbosity 51은 구간 안이지만 숨은 추론이 205(출력의 74%)로, 실측·보고된 ox-alpha의 0과 정면 충돌. 규칙대로 판정한다 — 다만 실패의 모양(가중치성 축 2개는 일치, 설정성 축만 어긋남)이 그 자체로 발견이다.

reference_en: Reference (not the judgment): leave-one-out family identification over the core-14 — v2 axes 8/10 vs v1 axes 5/10; v1's two surviving axes alone: 2/10. Protocol frozen before the comparison and published with this site (fingerprint protocol).
reference_ko: 참고 수치(본판정 아님): core-14 leave-one-out 가족 판별 — v2 축 8/10 vs v1 축 5/10; v1 생존 2축만으로는 2/10. 프로토콜은 비교 전에 동결됐고 이 사이트와 함께 공개된다(지문 프로토콜).
